edges.reason: The crafting table is co-located with the anvil in the workshop area; finding the anvil navigates player to crafting supplies
The crafting table needed for birch_slab recipe is in the workshop area marked by the anvil
The barrel is placed adjacent to the potted_acacia_sapling in the garden area; finding the sapling locates the barrel
Polished diorite slabs form the floor of the garden area near the potted_acacia_sapling; player must navigate there first
The villager trading post is behind the orange_stained_glass window; finding the glass locates the merchant
The emerald and compass required for the villager trade are stored inside the barrel; player must loot them first

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The anvil is at spawn-relative (5, 0, 6) in the workshop area east of spawn. Player must navigate within 5 blocks and face it to demonstrate visual discovery. max_distance=5 requires meaningful navigation from spawn (7.8 blocks away).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The potted acacia sapling is at spawn-relative (-6, 0, 5) in the garden area west of spawn. Player must navigate within 5 blocks and face it to demonstrate visual discovery. max_distance=5 requires meaningful navigation from spawn (7.8 blocks away).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The orange stained glass window is centered at spawn-relative (0, 1, -10) in the marketplace north of spawn. max_distance=5 (reduced from 8 per ValidatorAgent feedback) ensures player must navigate to approximately z=-5 or closer while facing north, requiring meaningful movement from spawn at z=0.

Uses inventory_has because mining polished_diorite_slab with the provided iron_pickaxe drops the slab item into inventory. The slabs are at y=-1 (floor level) in the garden area. Player does not start with this item and it's not available elsewhere in the scene, so its presence confirms successful mining.

Uses inventory_has because crafting orange_wool (shapeless recipe: 1 orange_dye + 1 white_wool) places the result in inventory. Player starts with orange_dye and white_wool but NOT orange_wool, so its presence confirms crafting was completed at the workshop crafting table.

Uses inventory_has because crafting birch_slab (shaped recipe: 3 birch_planks in a row → 6 birch_slabs) places the result in inventory. Player starts with birch_planks but NOT birch_slab, so its presence confirms crafting was completed.

Uses inventory_has because the barrel at (-5, 0, 5) contains 2 emeralds and 1 compass (placed via /item replace block). Emeralds are not available anywhere else in the scene and not in starting inventory, so having an emerald confirms the barrel was opened and looted. After trading 1 emerald away, player still retains 1 emerald (barrel had 2), keeping this milestone satisfied.

Uses inventory_has because the villager's custom trade (buy=emerald, buyB=compass, sell=map) produces a map item when completed. Maps are not available anywhere else in the scene and not in starting inventory, so having a map confirms the player successfully traded away their emerald and compass to the villager.

scene_description: A compact village scene with three distinct areas arranged around spawn: (1) Workshop area (east, x=4-8, z=2-6) with anvil, crafting table, and oak log/plank construction; (2) Garden/storage area (west, x=-8 to -4, z=2-6) with polished diorite slab flooring, stone brick walls, potted acacia sapling, and barrel containing emerald+compass; (3) Marketplace (north, z=-10 to -7) with orange stained glass window, oak construction, and a stationary cartographer villager offering emerald+compass→map trade. Areas connected by gravel paths through spawn.
task_text: Explore this village to find the anvil workshop, craft orange wool and birch slabs, locate the potted acacia sapling garden to open the barrel and mine the polished diorite floor, then find the orange stained glass marketplace to sell an Emerald and Compass to the villager.
design_notes: Final production-ready scene targeting Minecraft 1.17-1.20.4. All critical fixes applied: (1) /item replace block for barrel contents ensures version compatibility; (2) villager trade uses minecraft:map (not deprecated empty_map); (3) spatial layout supports all dependency edges with three distinct navigable areas. Player given: iron_pickaxe, 4 orange_dye, 4 white_wool, 6 birch_planks. Key coordinates: Anvil (5,0,6), Crafting table (7,0,6), Potted acacia sapling (-6,0,5), Barrel (-5,0,5), Orange stained glass (-1 to 1, 1-2, -10), Villager (0,0,-9), Polished diorite slab floor (-8 to -4, -1, 2 to 6).
